subject: Re: Q2 pipeline shortfall — nudge & proposed stage reset play
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Elaine Park <elaine.park@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Jun 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pipeline shortfall — urgent stage updates required

Team —

Quick note after the finance forecast run: we are ~22% shy of the commit targets for Q2 once we normalize for churn and conversion lag. I attached a high-level snapshot (Q2-pipeline-snapshot.xlsx). Key asks:

- Please update Stage and Commit fields for any open opps you own by EOD Thursday. I flagged the high-risk deals in the sheet.
- If you believe an opportunity should move to Closed-Lost or needs a move to "Needs Exec Help", add a short note in the HS record and ping me.
- Marcus/Logan: I need your consolidated commit number for the week by Friday morning — we will use that in the finance bridge.

Proposed short-term play: a one-time stage reset for deals that haven't had owner activity in 21+ days. Reset will be: Stalled -> MQL (re-qualify) or Move to Closed-Lost. This is to avoid overstating coverage. I want feedback on risks by EOD tomorrow.

Attachments: Q2-pipeline-snapshot.xlsx (sheet: flagged_deals)

Thanks,
Olga
Olga Petrov
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

--

Subject: Re: Pipeline shortfall — proposed stage reset & commit clarifications

Olga / Marcus —

I pushed my owners to update last night; summary below:
- ACME-4921: moved from Proposal -> Negotiation; owner notes legal ETA 6/25, conservative commit = $120k (50% confidence).
- Brightline-230: moved to Closed-Lost (no response after 6 outreach attempts).
- Nimbus-181: flagged as "Needs Exec Help" — exec ping scheduled for 6/21.

Agreed that the stage reset is reasonable for stale opps, but we should exempt any deal with an active legal or procurement thread (otherwise we risk hiding legitimate pipeline). I'll add a filter in HubSpot for "last owner activity" < 21d and "legal thread active" = false.

I can do consolidated commit by Friday 06/21 09:00 PST.

Logan

Date: Thu, 20 Jun 2029 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q2 pipeline shortfall — nudge & proposed stage reset play

Thanks everyone for the quick work. Short summary and decisions: 

1) Stage reset rule: apply to opps with last_owner_activity >21 days AND legal_thread_active = false. Marcus/Ben to run once on Friday morning and push changes (Ben will take the list ownership).
2) Exemptions: Do not reset deals with a legal/procurement thread or an assigned exec assist.
3) Commit consolidation: Logan to send consolidated commit by Fri 06/21 09:00 PST; Marcus to add caveats inline for ACME-4921 and ACME-5003.
4) Finance & RevOps handoff: Laura — please pull pre/post-reset coverage and leave a one-slide note for the Friday sync. Link: https://hubspot.com/HS-987654
5) External comms: Elaine — we will not change any public-facing language; this is internal hygiene only.

Next steps: Ben to run the >21d filter Friday 07:00 PT, push stage updates using the attached template, then we'll do a quick pass before the finance bridge. If any AE resists a reset, escalate to me and Laura.

Thanks — aggressive but necessary.

Olga

I'll be on the bridge at 09:30 PT on Friday for the handoff.
